answer: Two keys must turn in the same block on the registry's meadow before a tree joins its orchard: applicant and bonded verifier each hold half of a split key, and both halves must land in one block or both burn. The k-th tree under one funding rail needs k ceremonies in that block, each slot $25 by registry rule; a fresh rail costs $50 and a week. Unused halves freeze in the tundra at block close, each nonce drawn fresh for that block only, so no farm can pre-raise ceremonies. Forging 1,000 puppets costs $25×(1+…+1,000) = $12,512,500; one honest tree costs $25.
